attempts.bug_summary: When throttling is enabled, a model containing only content inserted before the element is processed immediately instead of being wrapped in the deferred processable flow. This causes before-model handling to bypass the engine's queued execution state when combined with throttling.

attempts.bug_summary: When both before-model content and a non-processable after-model are present, the after-model is routed through the processor handler instead of the downstream handler. This can cause inserted after-content to undergo unintended processor execution when a separate processor has also inserted content before the element.
